overview: Q+ is a public services portal app with a 9-category browse grid, backend-driven announcements feed, admin panel, and placeholder detail pages for each service category.
features: 9-category service grid (Library, Marketplace, Real Estate, Tourism, News, Education, Social, Health, Jobs)
Backend-driven announcements feed on home screen
Fixed bottom navigation with Home, Services, Profile tabs
Category detail placeholder pages with back navigation
Admin panel in Profile tab to add and delete announcements
Login via Internet Identity to access admin features
Minimal government-style clean UI matching provided mock
